query: SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messaging.email_outbox o WHERE o.template_id = $1 AND o.subject_ids @> ARRAY[$2, $3]::uuid[] AND o.status = 'sent' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messaging.email_event e WHERE e.provider_id = o.provider_id AND e.kind = 'email.bounced')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messaging.outbox t WHERE t.template_id = $1 AND t.subject_ids @> ARRAY[$2, $3]::uuid[] AND t.status = 'sent')) AS "yes!"
